messages.subject: Project Cedar - W&I policy
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Quick one on Project Cedar (the Crestview deal) - has the warranty & indemnity policy with Aldgate Specialty been bound yet? Our IC wants confirmation before signing. Apologies if this should have gone to the deal team rather than you directly.

Daniel
